notes.title: Added country capitals!
notes.content:
Check out these new features!
[list]
[*] Now find and type country capitals!
[*] Countries now highlight when you hover over them.
[*] Added new themes for the globe.
[*] Removed the bearing indicator in Find mode. Now, when you are wrong three times, you will automatically be taken to the correct country/capital.
[*] Improved user interface.
[*] Improved controls.
[/list]
